audit_kind: Independent recalculation from fetched GitHub per-seed records
method: Equal weight per seed; sample SD; two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval.
spectral_scope: One eligible 784x784 hidden matrix; model confidence/tail average equals its ordinary fitted alpha.
limits: All 60 checkpoint paths and byte sizes audited against the repository. The five SGDM 20,000-update checkpoints were downloaded and verified by both Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256; weights were not reloaded or re-evaluated. Metrics recomputed statistically from per-seed measured values, not from raw predictions.

sgdm_20000_checkpoint_content_verificati.method: Downloaded each checkpoint from the immutable GitHub commit; recomputed the Git blob SHA-1 including its byte-length header and matched the repository blob; computed SHA-256 over the checkpoint bytes.
